name: Ono
overview: Ono is identified in Scripture as a town belonging to the tribe of Benjamin, built by the sons of Elpaal, as noted in 1 Chronicles 8:12. It is associated with nearby towns such as Lod and is described as part of the valley of craftsmen in Nehemiah 11:35, indicating its role as a center of skilled labor. Additionally, the plain of Ono served as a strategic location during Nehemiah's time, where adversaries attempted to lure him under false pretenses, revealing the town's significance in the historical and spiritual challenges faced by God's people.
